meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成可交互的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作带分支导航和演讲者备注的交互式幻灯片
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create interactive slides with branching and speaker notes

howto.what: Claude 可以创作 HyperFrames 幻灯片（演示文稿、互动 deck），包含离散幻灯片、fragment 揭示、分支、热点导航和演讲者笔记；也能将现有页面转换为 deck。输出是可导航的 deck，不是 MP4。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求制作幻灯片（slideshow、slide show、HyperFrames slideshow）时直接触发。当用户要求“演示文稿”、“pitch deck”、“deck”、“interactive deck”或“将此页面转换为 deck”时，先确认意图。若通过 /hyperframes 路由，则确认已由意图层处理。BRIEF.md 存在时读取其中确认。
